sources.claim: Kalshi markets indicate a 56% chance Khamenei will be out of power before July 2026 and a 64% chance he will be gone by September 2026.
Kalshi traders assign 49% odds to abolishing the post, 24% for Hassan Khomeini, and 14% for Mojtaba Khamenei; abolition is the leading market outcome.
Prediction News notes Kalshi traders assigning a 64% chance that Khamenei is out as Supreme Leader by September 2026.
CryptoBriefing reports prediction-market odds around 65% for Khamenei stepping down by end-2026; separate contracts show 46% by March 31 and Kalshi pricing exit before 2027 at about 66%.

Benzinga reports March 1, 2026 scenarios where Mojtaba Khamenei, abolition, and Ali Larijani are among the top predicted outcomes after a hypothetical death event, with Mojtaba around 27% and abolition around 23% in Kalshi markets.
Markets forecast a Khamenei exit before 2027, with a 56% chance before July and 64% by September.
Kalshi traders assign notable odds to a leadership transition before 2027, including probabilities around abolition of the post and candidate odds for potential successors.
LA Times explains succession mechanics: emergency interim leadership and eventual selection of a new leader by the Assembly of Experts.
Washington Post reports the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and outlines the succession process.
ITV News discusses the disruption to Iran's regime and the succession challenge following Khamenei's death.
AP News reports that Iran’s leadership crisis escalated as strikes occurred in the context of Khamenei's death.
AP reports Ali Khamenei has died at age 86; death reported by Iranian state media after a joint US-Israeli operation.
Washington Post reports Khamenei has died and outlines succession mechanics.
Guardian reports Iranian state media confirming Khamenei's death following US-Israeli strikes.
Time reports Ali Khamenei was killed in a strike and is dead.
